notes: Copr chroots the release build targets (publish-copr submits '.targets | keys'). epel-9/epel-10 cover AlmaLinux/Rocky/RHEL 9/10. Both x86_64 and aarch64 are built.

One package comes out of one SRPM: the base 'php-pinba' built against each target's distro-native PHP — no Remi needed at build or run time. A PHP extension has no arch-specific build inputs, so aarch64 needs no extra vendoring (unlike the engine's storage-engine plugin).

base_php_version is the distro-native PHP for that target (Fedora base repos / EL AppStream). Informational: the base build always runs and picks up whatever php-devel the chroot ships. On EL, php-devel resolves from the default php module stream without an explicit module_enable.

Parallel-installable builds for specific PHP versions (Remi SCL/module streams) are shipped by Remi's own repository, which packages this fork upstream since v1.4.0 (issue #58). This Copr no longer builds php<XY>-php-pinba subpackages, so no Remi external repo is needed on any chroot.
